effects.burst_damage_formula: current Damage per second × current duration × 0.75
effects.launch_direction: directly away from the mech position sampled when the field ends

expected_effect.narrative: the launch turning grouping into deliberate dispersal

rules.text: When a field ends, it emits a burst dealing 75% of that field's full-duration damage budget: `current Damage per second × current duration × 0.75`.
Ordinary survivors are launched 4M directly away from the mech's position sampled when the field ends; bosses receive resisted displacement.
The burst has the current field radius and can damage each target once.
Expected full-stay damage is 175% of the base field, with the launch turning grouping into deliberate dispersal.
